# DATAFUSE Studio

> Senior software agency designing and shipping refined web apps, mobile apps and AI products. Production-ready MVP in 15 days from $15,000.

DATAFUSE Studio is led by Enzo Viana. We partner with founders and scale-ups to turn ideas into production software — focused scope, fixed price, full source-code ownership.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Agency overview, services, portfolio, founder, FAQ and contact.
- [15-day MVP offer](/offer/mvp): Flagship fixed-price $15,000 MVP delivered in 15 days.

## Services

- [Web app development](/services/web): Production-grade web platforms on TypeScript, React and Postgres.
- [Mobile app development](/services/mobile): Native-feel cross-platform apps with React Native / Expo.
- [Product design](/services/design): UI/UX design, design systems and brand-driven interfaces.
- [AI integration](/services/ai): LLM features, RAG, agents and AI-powered product flows.

## Case studies

- [Medialink SAAS](/portfolio/medialink-saas): SaaS, mobile app and no-code CMS for self-service kiosks.
- [Dimotec Contrôle](/portfolio/dimotec-controle): Field-ops platform — quotes, in-person signature, mission orders and loyalty.
- [Rio Ave FC](/portfolio/rio-ave-fc): Official mobile app for the Portuguese football club.
